name: Spatial-Ratio Neural Field Configuration
definition: A multi-plane implicit representation modeling a 4D voxel space (x, y, z, e) using six 2D planes to predict Gaussian transformations conditioned on an elastic ratio e.
summary: The Spatial-Ratio Neural Field predicts 3D Gaussian transformations via a multi-plane implicit representation conditioned on an elastic ratio, enabling dynamic Gaussian count adjustments without quality loss.
